If you were Born before September 1, 1993, YOU DO NOT NEED A BOATERS CERTIFICATION Swimming is at your own risk - Life jackets/vests MUST be worn at all times when in the water - There can be no exceptions.
Watercraft drivers must be at least 18 years to drive any of our motorized boat products.
TEXAS BOATER SAFETY CARD REQUIREMENT Watercraft drivers between the ages of 18-25 are required to hold a Texas Boater Safety Card as mandated by Texas Parks and Wildlife.
Submitting a reservation and failing to complete/obtain the Texas Boater Safety Card will result in forfeiture of all monies paid and cancellation of the reservation with no future rescheduling.
Alcohol Yes, you are permitted to bring and drink alcohol on our boats.
All customers must be at least 21 years old to consume alcohol.
Drivers must obey all Texas laws regarding operating boats/alcohol.
BOAT LICENSE: No boating license or training is required to drive any Sam’s Dock personal watercraft.
NOTE: If you are between the ages of 18-25, you are required by the State of Texas to obtain and present the Boater Safety card.

services.desc: Enjoy the twinkle light parade on Lake Grapevine! Duration At least 1 hour About Enjoy the twinkle light parade on Lake Grapevine and view the best decorated boats in DFW aboard a 50 passenger party boat departing from Twin Coves Marina on Lake Grapevine, arrival time is 5pm and the cruise departs at 5:45 -- BYOB! Cruise time is at least one hour or longer. Rockin S Bar and Grill will be open after the cruise with music and options to buy food and drinks at the restaurant. Call 469-404-6247 with any questions. This is an open deck boat so dress warm with hats, gloves and bring hand warmers along with heavy jackets. It is always colder on the water so keep this in mind. HAPPY
